title: The Offering that Altered Destiny
intro: In the earliest days of humanity, a soul offered a gift with pure intentions. Yet, envy lurked in the shadow of acceptance. Discover the story of this figure whose piety and tragic end are immortalized in divine revelation.
clues: I was among the very first generations of mankind.
I presented an offering to my Lord, and it was received with favor.
My brother's offering was rejected, and envy darkened his heart.
I told him, 'If you stretch your hand towards me to kill me, I will not stretch my hand to kill you; indeed I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds.'
I became the victim of the first act of murder on earth.
My blood cried out, and I was the first martyr of innocence.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
